mapper.select: SELECT r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, TO_CHAR(r.requested_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS requestedAt, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS name, r.total_refund_amount AS totalRefundAmount, r.refund_reason AS refundReason, ri.refund_item_no AS refundItemNo, ri.order_item_no AS orderItemNo, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.item_color AS itemColor, oi.item_size AS itemSize, ri.refund_quantity AS refundQuantity, ri.refund_amount AS refundAmount, ri.refund_status AS refundItemStatus FROM refund r JOIN member m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN refund_item ri ON r.refund_no = ri.refund_no JOIN order_item oi ON ri.order_item_no = oi.order_item_no WHERE r.refund_no = #{refundNo} ORDER BY ri.refund_item_no ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM refund_item WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND refund_status != 'COMPLETED'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT inner_data.*, ROWNUM rn FROM ( SELECT r.refund_no AS refundNo, r.order_no AS orderNo, r.refund_status AS refundStatus, TO_CHAR(r.requested_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS requestedAt, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS name, r.total_refund_amount AS totalRefundAmount, ri.refund_item_no AS refundItemNo, ri.order_item_no AS orderItemNo, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.item_color AS itemColor, oi.item_size AS itemSize, ri.refund_quantity AS refundQuantity, ri.refund_amount AS refundAmount, ri.refund_status AS refundItemStatus FROM refund r JOIN member m ON r.member_no = m.member_no JOIN refund_item ri ON r.refund_no = ri.refund_no JOIN order_item oi ON ri.order_item_no = oi.order_item_no WHERE r.refund_no IN ( SELECT refund_no FROM ( SELECT r2.refund_no FROM refund r2 JOIN member m2 ON r2.member_no = m2.member_no WHERE 1 = 1
AND r2.refund_status = #{status}
AND ( TO_CHAR(r2.refund_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(r2.order_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR LOWER(m2.member_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM refund_item ri3 JOIN order_item oi3 ON ri3.order_item_no = oi3.order_item_no WHERE ri3.refund_no = r2.refund_no AND LOWER(oi3.item_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
ORDER BY r2.refund_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{page} * #{size} MINUS SELECT refund_no FROM ( SELECT r3.refund_no FROM refund r3 JOIN member m3 ON r3.member_no = m3.member_no WHERE 1 = 1
AND r3.refund_status = #{status}
AND ( TO_CHAR(r3.refund_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR TO_CHAR(r3.order_no) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR LOWER(m3.member_id) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM refund_item ri4 JOIN order_item oi4 ON ri4.order_item_no = oi4.order_item_no WHERE ri4.refund_no = r3.refund_no AND LOWER(oi4.item_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
ORDER BY r3.refund_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= (#{page} - 1) * #{size} ) ORDER BY r.refund_no DESC, ri.refund_item_no ASC ) inner_data ) ORDER BY refundNo DESC, refundItemNo ASC
